title: A novel Single Alpha-Helix-DNA-binding domain in CAF-1 promotes gene silencing and DNA damage survival through tetrasome-length DNA selectivity and spacer function
authors: Ruben Rosas; Rhiannon R. Aguilar; Nina Arslanovic; Jessica K. Tyler; Mair E. A. Churchill
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CAF-1中单α螺旋结构域与DNA的结合选择性及间隔功能，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作，但非典型TF-DNA体系，且方法以结构生物学和体内功能为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，故评6分。
abstract: The histone chaperone chromatin assembly factor 1 (CAF-1) deposits nascent histone H3/H4 dimers onto newly replicated DNA forming the central core of the nucleosome known as the tetrasome. How CAF-1 ensures there is sufficient space for the assembly of tetrasomes remains unknown. Structural and biophysical characterization of the lysine/glutamic acid/arginine-rich (KER) region of CAF-1 revealed a 128 Å single alpha helix (SAH) motif with unprecedented DNA binding properties. Distinct KER sequence features and length of the SAH drive the selectivity of CAF-1 for tetrasome-length DNA and facilitate function in budding yeast. In vivo , the KER cooperates with the DNA-binding winged helix domain in CAF-1 to overcome DNA damage sensitivity and maintain silencing of gene expression. We propose that the KER SAH links functional domains within CAF-1 with structural precision, acting as a DNA binding spacer element during chromatin assembly.
abstract_zh: 组蛋白伴侣染色质组装因子1（CAF-1）将新合成的组蛋白H3/H4二聚体沉积到新复制的DNA上，形成核小体的核心结构，即四聚体（tetrasome）。CAF-1如何确保有足够空间供四聚体组装仍属未知。对CAF-1中赖氨酸/谷氨酸/精氨酸富集（KER）区域的结构和生物物理表征揭示了一个128 Å的单α螺旋（SAH）基序，其具有前所未有的DNA结合特性。KER序列的独特特征及SAH的长度驱动了CAF-1对四聚体长度DNA的选择性，并促进其在芽殖酵母中的功能。在体内，KER与CAF-1中的DNA结合翼状螺旋结构域协同作用，以克服DNA损伤敏感性并维持基因表达的沉默。我们提出，KER SAH以结构精度连接CAF-1内的功能结构域，在染色质组装过程中充当DNA结合间隔元件。
